children: On October 15, 2026 at 07:00, Carasent AB (publ) will publish its interim report for the third quarter of 2026.
Carasent will host a presentation of the report as a webcast on the same day at 08:00 CEST.
If you wish to participate via webcast, please use the link below:

If you wish to participate via teleconference, please register using the link below. After registration, you will receive phone numbers and a conference ID to access the conference. You can ask questions verbally via the teleconference.
